commonContracts.authority: C is trusted backend-only context(sessionId UUID, selectedOrg UUID, liveOrg UUID, environment live|sandbox, expectedAuthorityRevision bigint). No actor/role/mask/action/table fields from HTTP may confer authority. Adapter validates real cookie then SQL derives actual user/membership/persona. Admission includes org-state authority revision, actual member ID/native role/status, assignment+template revision, current session/consent/partner and schema-contract revision. Keys are fixed PERMS18; assigned explicit set is never intersected with old native ceiling.
commonContracts.persona: Global staff-first is mandatory: canonical getSession resolution across live memberships is authoritative, including hidden memberships. Staff in A plus tenant in B cannot request tenant/owner export/reader through B to bypass staff floors. Vendor token is a separate persona path and never becomes a staff export credential. This staff custom-role export endpoint is staff only; genuine tenant/owner/vendor self-exports are existing separate features and are not invented here. Each chunk/file admission repeats global persona, not a selected-org-only membership lookup.
commonContracts.selectors: Selectors are fixed per operation, 25 choices/page max, bounded q<=100 chars, exact org/env/resource admission, IDs+labels+currency/status only. They cannot be exported, recursively expanded, joined to unrestricted contacts or treated as a fullread API. Explicit edit target may return only the exact fields needed to edit that one admitted object; request cannot enumerate arbitrary tables/fields. Current raw current page queries need splitting where list and edit forms are combined. tickets.update and messages.send have explicitly declared existing workspace read+write semantics; month.close has only its explicitly existing B014 typed history extension, not raw journal access. All other write-only grants remain selector/target/receipt scope.
commonContracts.governance: Only native Admin plus effective team.manage governs custom roles, native Admin transitions or any transition removing a mandatory persona floor. Delegated team.manage manages ordinary nonself members/invitations within full RESULTING actor ceiling, including unassigned default rights. Serialize org/member/template/assignment/invitation and last usable Admin checks. Cover suspend/deactivate -> invitation issue/accept -> reactivation/base-role replacement as one effective floor analysis; an Accountant cannot evade photo denial by becoming Manager through a delegated two-step path. Actor cannot change self directly or via template. Preserve existing billing-owner check/unique index; no new recovery superuser. Expected revisions compare actual member and assignments, not coarse UI counts.
commonContracts.exportStart: POST /api/export/all is a fixed user-initiated read/download route with same-origin/consent checks and data.export; request accepts only approved report period and includeFiles boolean. Server chooses ALL manifest collections; no caller collection/table/field/mask/actor/role or SQL fragment. No external message/upload occurs. Allocate random exportId only as correlation, not authority. Capture canonical context and revisions server-side; no caller-supplied revision can create a grant. Unsupported period/filter is invalid, no unbounded range. includeFiles defaults true. If explicitly false, header requestedScope=regular_structured_only and file families are NOT_REQUESTED; never label that result all regular files. No client-selected collection mask is introduced.
commonContracts.capture: Structured data uses one bounded repeatable-read READ ONLY capture transaction. Per collection fixed ID-keyset queries collect up to5000 rows,250/page,20000 overall and16MiB normalized UTF8 total; capture wall limit30s. Order by typed immutable source ID (audit uses existing UTC microsecond+ID keyset), retain duplicates where contract permits. Reuse source calculations and currency-safe integer strings. No OFFSET for all-data adapters. Limits are operational safety bounds, not commercial plan values. LIMIT+1 detects truncation; record TRUNCATED_LIMIT with continuation-available marker, no claim complete. A capture may not hold organization or authority row locks while bytes stream. After capture COMMIT, perform a FRESH current admission/revision check in another short read transaction and discard captured bytes if drift before any content leaves. This checks revocation that a repeatable-read snapshot could not see. Do not keep old snapshot/connection/locks alive across network/storage or response streaming.
commonContracts.delivery: Stream NDJSON contract3: header, collection_manifest, rows, per-file start/chunks/end, terminal_manifest. Auth and expected authority revision checked fresh before every <=1MiB structured batch/file chunk and at terminal footer; every file rechecks exact current resource audience and immutable metadata/hash before/after internal fetch. Each check transaction ends before writing bytes. On session/consent/persona/schema/authority drift abort further rows/files and emit terminal incomplete marker if transport still open; otherwise client treats missing terminal complete as incomplete. Already delivered bytes cannot be recalled and no instantaneous wall-clock revocation guarantee is claimed. This is bounded snapshot capture plus revalidated delivery, not lock-across-stream authorization. Cross-request resume is deliberately unsupported; restart a new export with new current authority, never use unsigned cursor/exportId as capability.
commonContracts.files: File metadata is itself gated before enumerating/counting. Max32 files,8MiB each,128MiB cumulative,180s total export lifetime; all limits include generated documents. Opaque filename/path content cannot prove safety; unknown sensitivity/classification yields UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT and no bytes. Hash+size/MIME/path allowlist and exact owning record are verified; generated existing PDFs retain original templates and are labeled generated. Use server internal fetch/render and audited proxy bytes, never export signed URLs/storage paths. Native Accountant denial covers protected photos through ticket, expense and message alternate associations; native Admin audit only allows masked AuditView, never raw audit JSON. No raw identity files, full account numbers, session/MFA/invite/LINE/provider secrets in any output.
commonContracts.markers: Each finite collection/file family gets one status: INCLUDED, EMPTY_AUTHORIZED, DENIED_PERMISSION, DENIED_PERSONA, DENIED_MANDATORY_FLOOR, SELECTOR_ONLY, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, TRUNCATED_LIMIT, REVOKED_OR_REVISION_CHANGED, NOT_REQUESTED. NOT_REQUESTED applies only to the explicit includeFiles=false scope and never masquerades as complete all-data/file coverage. Unauthorized collection count is null and no IDs/names/counts leak; empty authorized count=0. Per-field redactions use fixed field names plus reason code, never hidden values or actual hidden counts. overallComplete is false if ANY denied, redacted, unsupported, unavailable, truncated or revoked collection/file exists; never label partial/denied package complete. A separate deliveredAuthorizedCollections count reports successful scope without implying missing datasets absent. Header declares fixed private-field exclusions from the regular-data contract. Missing terminal manifest means incomplete. Complete only means all declared regular contract3 datasets/files for this request were delivered without such markers, never a raw database backup or whole B017 acceptance.
commonContracts.privateExclusions: Never project auth.users passwords/provider identities; auth_sessions row/token/hash/UUID; MFA secret/recovery codes; invitations code_hash/token; contacts user_id/LINE ID/channel credentials; files storage_bucket/storage_path/signedURL; raw organizations.settings/feature_flags/provider config; raw bank details/full account/routing/holder data; bank_transactions.raw/import bytes; raw ledger_transactions.reason or ledger_entries.memo; raw audit old_row/new_row; private B010/B014/B015/B017/B018 commands/digests; existing internal reversal/rejection note by indirect join; identity-document photos/bytes/encryption references; legal/privacy/terms text not already existing rendered document. Existing ordinary user-written ticket/message/expense text is exported only through its exact authorized workspace reader; no false promise to remove a phone someone typed in free text.
commonContracts.raw: Per-operation bridge maps actual source calls, not global has_role rewriting. Current schema generic team_read/insert/update/delete, org_members members_admin, contacts/profiles teammate SELECT, listing_terms policies and owner_lease_tenants definer view all require exact source-bound B017 gates. Assigned broad raw SELECT is denied; safe fixed readers return declared columns. Ordinary staff enrolled writes use exact fixed functions; current service/owner queries (bank-matching.authorize, B003, B007/B010/B014, archive, PDFs) need explicit effective admission and old-worker/credential fencing. No PUBLIC execute, no caller arbitrary field masks or bypass via set_config/SET ROLE. Actual target ACL/owner/FORCE-RLS remain unverified until the authored inactive SQL and nonMac evidence; Codex owns this manifest and implementation, PE owns actual target proof/application.
commonContracts.newReaderGaps: Required minimal NEW read adapters: safe unit/room/link projection; tenant-phone fixed projection; current-safe invoice/line/payment-history/expense-financial keyset readers; all-period utility summary index; bounded per-family adapters replacing fixed40/50 or unbounded current lists; masked audit page/export wrapper; B017 private role/assignment projection; explicit expense-receipt and message-attachment byte reader/classification; repair authenticated byte proxy; export manifest/capture/delivery coordinator. Reuse actual existing DTOs/calculations and fixed existing PDF builders. No financial math rewrite, new regular-data permission key, full raw ledger reader, new domain feature or legal copy is needed. Matched/archived bank history and arbitrary schema-only attachments have no current safe read surface and are explicitly OUTSIDE_CURRENT_READABLE_CONTRACT; do not invent mandatory new B017 domain scope. The six listed requested file families which lack a byte reader are marked NOT_IMPLEMENTED when includeFiles=true until their fixed authorized reader is delivered. These are concrete Codex work, not unspecified PE design. The current pay.record label mentions add charges, but no new arbitrary charge-issuing command is created by B017; only existing native source operations get this bridge. Missing B008 issuing work remains its already-started capability, not a fabricated B017 gateway.
commonContracts.baseline: All37 v2 source pins are reconciled against immutable b8c4134fde7bbce933c1206137b9d92f4a55667f. Additional actual reader files are pinned at the same baseline. Current working-source hashes are recorded separately; B018 changed files are not imported as new B017 design authority and B017 status/doc drift is disclosed. No app/SQL/reservation/runtime/DB/parser/browser/network/Downloads mutation by this task. Only these two workspace design reports authored.
